item.description: As the SaMD market grows toward $120.5 billion by 2030, a new seminar series aims to help healthcare startups navigate regulatory requirements and quality strategies from the outset.

item.title: In Vivo Gene Editing Trial Shows Sustained Effect at 18-Month Mark

item.title: Telehealth Network Backed by Regional Insurers Expands Into Four Southeast Asian Markets
item.description: The platform pairs async symptom triage with live video consults, aiming to cut average time-to-specialist from weeks to days.

item.title: Needle-Free Continuous Glucose Sensor Enters Final-Stage Trials
